description: Go runtime and OS process metrics for each Weaviate node.

panels.description: `process_resident_memory_bytes` (gauge). Resident memory size in bytes.
panels.title: Resident memory (RSS)

panels.description: `go_goroutines` (gauge). Number of goroutines that currently exist.
panels.title: Goroutines

panels.description: `go_gc_duration_seconds` (summary). A summary of the wall-time pause (stop-the-world) duration in garbage collection cycles.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (instance, pod) (rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance, pod) (rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")

panels.title: GC pause (mean)

panels.description: `go_gc_gogc_percent` (gauge). Heap size target percentage configured by the user, otherwise 100. This value is set by the GOGC environment variable, and the runtime/debug.SetGCPercent function. Sourced from /gc/gogc:percent
panels.title: Go gc gogc percent

panels.description: `go_info` (gauge). Information about the Go environment.
panels.title: Go info

panels.description: `go_memstats_alloc_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes allocated in heap and currently in use. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/objects:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats alloc bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_alloc_bytes_total` (counter). Total number of bytes allocated in heap until now, even if released already. Equals to /gc/heap/allocs:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats alloc bytes total /s

panels.description: `go_memstats_buck_hash_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes used by the profiling bucket hash table. Equals to /memory/classes/profiling/buckets:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats buck hash sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_frees_total` (counter). Total number of heap objects frees. Equals to /gc/heap/frees:objects + /gc/heap/tiny/allocs:objects.
panels.title: Go memstats frees total /s

panels.description: `go_memstats_gc_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes used for garbage collection system metadata. Equals to /memory/classes/metadata/other:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats gc sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_heap_alloc_bytes` (gauge). Number of heap bytes allocated and currently in use, same as go_memstats_alloc_bytes. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/objects:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats heap alloc bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_heap_idle_bytes` (gauge). Number of heap bytes waiting to be used. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/released:bytes + /memory/classes/heap/free:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats heap idle bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_heap_objects` (gauge). Number of currently allocated objects. Equals to /gc/heap/objects:objects.
panels.title: Go memstats heap objects

panels.description: `go_memstats_heap_released_bytes` (gauge). Number of heap bytes released to OS. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/released:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats heap released bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_heap_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of heap bytes obtained from system. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/objects:bytes + /memory/classes/heap/unused:bytes + /memory/classes/heap/released:bytes + /memory/classes/heap/free:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats heap sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_last_gc_time_seconds` (gauge). Number of seconds since 1970 of last garbage collection.
panels.title: Go memstats last gc time seconds

panels.description: `go_memstats_mallocs_total` (counter). Total number of heap objects allocated, both live and gc-ed. Semantically a counter version for go_memstats_heap_objects gauge. Equals to /gc/heap/allocs:objects + /gc/heap/tiny/allocs:objects.
panels.title: Go memstats mallocs total /s

panels.description: `go_memstats_mcache_inuse_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes in use by mcache structures. Equals to /memory/classes/metadata/mcache/inuse:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats mcache inuse bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_mcache_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes used for mcache structures obtained from system. Equals to /memory/classes/metadata/mcache/inuse:bytes + /memory/classes/metadata/mcache/free:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats mcache sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_mspan_inuse_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes in use by mspan structures. Equals to /memory/classes/metadata/mspan/inuse:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats mspan inuse bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_mspan_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes used for mspan structures obtained from system. Equals to /memory/classes/metadata/mspan/inuse:bytes + /memory/classes/metadata/mspan/free:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats mspan sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_next_gc_bytes` (gauge). Number of heap bytes when next garbage collection will take place. Equals to /gc/heap/goal:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats next gc bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_other_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes used for other system allocations. Equals to /memory/classes/other:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats other sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_stack_inuse_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes obtained from system for stack allocator in non-CGO environments. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/stacks:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats stack inuse bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_stack_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes obtained from system for stack allocator. Equals to /memory/classes/heap/stacks:bytes + /memory/classes/os-stacks:bytes.
panels.title: Go memstats stack sys bytes

panels.description: `go_memstats_sys_bytes` (gauge). Number of bytes obtained from system. Equals to /memory/classes/total:byte.
panels.title: Go memstats sys bytes

panels.description: `go_sched_gomaxprocs_threads` (gauge). The current runtime.GOMAXPROCS setting, or the number of operating system threads that can execute user-level Go code simultaneously. Sourced from /sched/gomaxprocs:threads
panels.title: Go sched gomaxprocs threads

panels.description: `go_sched_latencies_seconds` (histogram). Distribution of the time goroutines have spent in the scheduler in a runnable state before actually running. Bucket counts increase monotonically. Sourced from /sched/latencies:seconds
panels.title: Go sched latencies seconds

panels.description: `go_threads` (gauge). Number of OS threads created.
panels.title: Go threads

panels.description: `process_network_receive_bytes_total` (counter). Number of bytes received by the process over the network.
panels.title: Process network receive bytes total /s

panels.description: `process_network_transmit_bytes_total` (counter). Number of bytes sent by the process over the network.
panels.title: Process network transmit bytes total /s

panels.description: `process_start_time_seconds` (gauge). Start time of the process since unix epoch in seconds.
panels.title: Process start time seconds

panels.description: `process_virtual_memory_bytes` (gauge). Virtual memory size in bytes.
panels.title: Process virtual memory bytes

panels.description: `process_virtual_memory_max_bytes` (gauge). Maximum amount of virtual memory available in bytes.
panels.title: Process virtual memory max bytes
